notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for standard pre-delivery negotiated ownership cancellation. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies that canceling the pending acquisition before negotiated callbacks are delivered suppresses stale divestiture and release notifications while ownership remains stable, without asserting provider-specific behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador negotiatedAttributeOwnershipDivestiture, cancelAttributeOwnershipAcquisition, cancelNegotiatedAttributeOwnershipDivestiture, and ownership-query services with standard ownership callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador ownership-management declarations
